applies_to.launch_mode: copilot -p <task> --output-format json --stream on --no-auto-update --no-ask-user --session-id <id> (see the fixture provenance for the whole command)
applies_to.capture_route: stdout captured by the run script
applies_to.route_limit: standard output only; the native session file, the OTel export and the usage report are separate specifications

provenance.reviewed: 2026-10-24 level-1 assembly phase: variants, data-keyed and map-keyed paths reviewed against the 1.0.100 recordings, including the copilot-2 checkpoint regression (nested accounting under map-keyed paths stays inventoried); per-tool telemetry (data.toolTelemetry) inventoried as the CLI's own fields after the source-availability gate found token metrics hidden under it

limits: one CLI version (1.0.100) and one launch per specification: the inventory is the observed shape of one sanitized live run (copilot-otel-1), not a vendor promise
a field observed in one record is not universal; a field absent from this specimen is not removed; nullability is what was seen
variants are discriminated by the vendor's own fields; a record with a new discriminator value is a new variant, not an error

data-keyed subtrees (tool arguments, tool-defined results, per-tool telemetry) record value kinds only; map-keyed subtrees (accounting keyed by model, agent or id) keep their vendor structure below {*}
EXPERIMENTAL route: no field-disposition catalog and no independent oracle profile yet; the assembly oracle judges the final assembly; admission needs both

the specimen was sanitized (session, event, call and request ids replaced by stand-ins; private context replaced by labelled placeholders with lengths and hashes); shapes and value kinds are unchanged

external_cross_checks.name: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.100 --help
external_cross_checks.use: attribute and option names compared by reading; no path-level comparison was run

availability.rule: agent-journal/source-availability 0.1: per fact family, whether this source reports it and where (selectors: variant and path, with the population the inventory observed); a family is absent only when no observed path matches its vocabulary; a selector that matches nothing is unexercised, never verified (SourceAvailability)

families.granularity: session cumulative (accountingSnapshot.tokenDetails), per model (modelMetrics, agentMetrics, providerModelMetrics) and the last call's full usage (lastCallInputTokens/lastCallOutputTokens with promptCacheBreakState cache counts); the other calls' per-call usage is not reported on this route (session usage records and OTel chat spans report it)
session premium requests and nano-AIU (checkpoint), the run's premium requests (result)
promptCacheBreakState system_segments carry segment hashes and token counts only, never the system text
